[F001] ### Summary

Implemented F001 (D005 fix) by adding `check_quota_caps()` to `scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py:392` that walks `quota_state.json` vendors × windows, cross-references `quota_caps.json` entries via the existing `quota_caps_loader.get()` helper, and emits one WARN `CheckResult` per signal-bearing `(vendor, tier, window)` pair without a cap entry — plus a separate WARN for any stale (`>STALE_WARNING_DAYS`) calibration block via `calibration_loader.is_stale()`. Each missing-cap WARN carries a copy-paste JSON snippet with the correct `cap.unit` (`percent_of_plan` for Claude weighted tokens, observed unit otherwise) and a 1.25× tuned starter value; stale-calibration WARN carries the exact `calibrate-claude --window …` command. Wired into `run_all_checks` (runs by default, not gated behind `--include-projects`). Added 7 fixture tests in `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_doctor_quota_caps.py` covering covered, missing-cap, stale-calibration, no-signal-skipped, missing-state-file-benign, full-runner-wiring, and an acceptance test that replays the three known-missing pairs.

$ python3 -m pytest scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_doctor_quota_caps.py -v
$ python3 -m pytest scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_f022_jarvis_doctor.py -v
$ python3 -m pytest scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/ -q
$ python3 scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py --skip-auth --json
$ python3 scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py --skip-auth

7 new tests + 21 existing doctor tests + 1815 orchestrate suite
